name: skill-bazaar
description: A curated marketplace of cross-tool AI agent skills and plugins.

plugins.name: mikrotik-routeros
plugins.description: Design, configure, audit, and troubleshoot MikroTik RouterOS networks — CAPsMAN/wifi, VLANs, firewall and multi-layer NAT, routing, DHCP, QoS, VPNs, and .rsc scripting.

plugins.name: agent-delegation
plugins.description: Protocol for handing work to a subagent that cannot ask the human mid-run: delegate by default with two main-session carve-outs (secret values, human confirmations), a decision-completeness gate, stop-clause wording, an ask-and-continue variant for harnesses with a parent relay, and artifact verification instead of exit codes.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Vendored, pinned copy of JuliusBrussee/caveman (MIT): ultra-compressed caveman-style replies that cut ~75% of output tokens while keeping technical substance exact.

plugins.name: limit-guard
plugins.description: Pause a Claude Code session before it burns through the 5-hour or 7-day usage window, wait for the reset without spending tokens, and resume automatically.

plugins.name: ste
plugins.description: Simple Technical English (ASD-STE100) bridged to caveman: caveman's compressed style stays the default, and STE takes over on exactly the turns caveman itself says to drop compression. Toggle with /ste on|off|status.
